label: create new
description: Create a new work item with a description and priority.

label: intake
description: Ensure that the selected item is reasonably well defined in terms of objectives.

label: plan
description: Run the plan workflow on the selected work item

label: implement
description: Run the implement workflow on the selected work item

label: Producer Review
description: Toggle the 'Needs Producer Review' flag.

label: Search
description: Search all workitems for keyword(s).

label: audit automatic
description: Trigger automatic audit of the selected work item.

command: !!wl reviewed <id> false && wl audit-set <id> --ready-to-close yes --summary 'Approved by manual review'
label: audit approve
description: Approve the in_review item by manual audit.

command: !!wl reviewed <id> false && wl audit-set <id> --ready-to-close no --summary 'Rejected by manual review. <reason>'
label: audit reject
description: Reject the in_review item by manual audit.

label: update priority low
description: Update the priority of the selected work item to low.

description: Update the priority of the selected work item to medium.

label: update priority high
description: Update the priority of the selected work item to high.

label: update priority critical
description: Update the priority of the selected work item to critical.

label: update stage/status
description: Update the stage of the selected work item

label: update title
description: Update the title of the selected work item

label: close done
description: Close the work item as done.

label: close deleted
description: Delete the work item.

command: /prompt:Review the current work item and suggest next steps
